purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for Order 103 after preserving and auditing the v84 baseline and v85 path-recovery attempt.
change_scope: One generic model-adaptation change: expose spreadsheet.write_range with model-selected sheet, range, and plain scalar values. The Adapter performs only deterministic scalar-to-typed-cell representation conversion and forwards the resulting matrix to Calc range.write.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: The model recovered the exact Desktop path, opened and read the workbook, but then selected spreadsheet.insert_matching_rows_into_document as a Calc mutation tool. Its search for spreadsheet insertion did not expose a plain Calc writer and the Agent entered a repeated rejected-action loop.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Tests use unrelated inventory worksheets, ranges, values, booleans, nulls, and a formula-looking literal string. They prove model arguments reach the Multi-Apps boundary unchanged, only scalar representation is converted, strings remain literal, matrices remain rectangular, ambiguous mixed shapes fail closed, and no task values or target cells are inferred.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The model must explicitly select spreadsheet.write_range and supply sheet, range, and values. The Runner does not replace or inject arguments; the Adapter converts only null, boolean, number, and string cells into Calc typed-cell objects.
implementation_evidence.instruction_top_k: spreadsheet.write_range is second in the unchanged Order-103 instruction Top-K, behind the read-only spreadsheet reader
implementation_evidence.exact_search_top_k: spreadsheet.write_range ranks first for the generic query spreadsheet insert row or cell; the Writer row-transfer facade ranks second and duplicate downstream Calc range.write is suppressed
implementation_evidence.ruff: all active integrations, scripts, tests, and Adapter packages passed
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this targeted A/B. If the model still fails to select or correctly use the generic writer, mark Order 103 task_blocked without trying a third hypothesis and immediately advance to Order 104.

selection.method: same Order-103 task as the preserved v84 baseline and v85 first-hypothesis attempt
